items.name: Section 2 Personnel Eligibility Verification v0.2.0
items.description: Uploads three workflow documents together — the VERAS proposal package, the Banner NBAJOBS extract, and the institutional Department List — and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Section 2 Review Report covering the per-person eligibility matrix (with APM 45.22 status), org-code-to-DGA mapping, DGA completeness assessment, action items for ineligible personnel and missing DGAs, and a review-completion checklist. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping section2-personnel-eligibility consolidation.md conventions.

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: University of Idaho Office of Sponsored Programs
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Primary KB — this KB contains the APM Section 45.22 eligible-titles list that drives PI / Co-PI eligibility determinations. Do NOT swap. When the operator does not attach a KB, every PI / Co-PI will come back as "Review Required" because the workflow cannot evaluate eligibility without the APM 45.22 reference.

data.name: extract-section-2-personnel
data.prompt:
You are extracting Section 2 personnel from a VERAS proposal
package. You receive the workflow documents AND any KB chunks
the previous step retrieved.

Be 100% accurate. Quote names and roles verbatim. Do not
invent personnel. Use null when a field is absent.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- section_21_personnel: JSON ARRAY of {name, role, institution}
  objects from VERAS Section 2.1. role is one of "PI",
  "Co-PI". institution is null when not stated. MUST contain
  at least one entry.
- section_22_personnel: JSON ARRAY of {name, role, institution}
  objects from VERAS Section 2.2A. role is always
  "Senior/Key Personnel". Empty array when Section 2.2A is
  not populated.
- proposal_identifier: STRING. Proposal identifier (number
  or title). null when absent.
- total_personnel_count: INTEGER.
- pi_copis_requiring_eligibility: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS
  (names from section_21_personnel).
- personnel_requiring_org_code_only: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS
  (names from section_22_personnel).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-eligibility-and-dga-verification
data.prompt:
You are performing eligibility and DGA verification. You
receive the workflow documents (VERAS, Banner NBAJOBS extract,
Department List) AND KB chunks (APM 45.22 eligible-titles
list).

Be 100% accurate. Do NOT assume employment, eligibility, or
DGA mapping. When a job title is ambiguous (clinical faculty,
lecturer, adjunct, dual appointment), emit eligibility_status
"Review Required" — never "Eligible" or "Not Eligible". When
a workflow document is missing, emit non-compliant defaults
and capture the gap in notes_about_missing_sources.

Senior / Key Personnel from Section 2.2A do NOT need
eligibility checks — they need org-code collection only.
Emit eligibility_status "N/A" for those rows.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- personnel_verification: JSON ARRAY of per-person
  {name, found_in_banner, current_employee, job_title,
   timesheet_org_code, notes} objects. One entry per person
  from Section 2.1 + Section 2.2A combined.
- eligibility_check: JSON ARRAY of per-PI / Co-PI
  {name, role, job_title, eligibility_status, evidence}
  objects. status one of "Eligible", "Not Eligible",
  "Review Required". evidence is a short APM 45.22 citation
  or rationale.
- org_code_compilation: JSON ARRAY of
  {org_code, personnel_names, count} objects.
- dga_mapping: JSON ARRAY of
  {org_code, department_name, dga_names} objects. department_name
  null and dga_names empty when the org code is not in the
  Department List.
- dga_cross_reference: JSON ARRAY of
  {dga_name, org_codes, listed_in_section_2, action_needed}
  objects. action_needed is one of "No action needed" or
  "FLAG — Must be added to Section 2".
- notes_about_missing_sources: STRING describing any source
  document that was not provided; null when all present.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: section2-personnel-eligibility-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Section 2 Personnel
Eligibility Verification workflow. You receive TWO JSON
fragments from the previous step (personnel extraction +
eligibility / DGA verification).

Render a single RA-friendly Markdown Section 2 Review
Report. The deliverable is Markdown — NOT a JSON object, NOT
a JSON code fence. Mirrors the source
ui-insight/ProcessMapping section2-personnel-eligibility
consolidation.md exactly.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: render the section with its empty-state
  language already specified below (e.g., "No items identified",
  "Defers to federal defaults", "None identified beyond
  standard federal requirements").

If EVERY field across ALL upstream fragments is null (which
means the document genuinely contained nothing extractable
OR the document was not attached to the run), STILL render
the full Markdown structure with "Not specified in the
document" placeholders throughout, AND append a single line
at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Section 2 Review Report: <proposal_identifier or "Not specified">

### SECTION 1: REVIEW OVERVIEW

- **Proposal:** <proposal_identifier or "Not specified">
- **Date of Review:** <today's date ISO YYYY-MM-DD>
- **Total Personnel in Section 2:** <total_personnel_count>
- **PI/Co-PIs Requiring Eligibility Check:** <pi_copis_requiring_eligibility.length>
- **Senior/Key Personnel (org code only):** <personnel_requiring_org_code_only.length>

---

### SECTION 2: PERSONNEL ELIGIBILITY MATRIX

| # | Name | Role | Job Title (Banner) | APM 45.22 Eligible | Org Code | DGA | Status |
|---|------|------|--------------------|--------------------|---------|----|--------|

One row per person in the combined Section 2.1 + Section
2.2A list. Sort by role: PI first, then Co-PI, then
Senior/Key Personnel. Pull Job Title and Org Code from
personnel_verification; APM 45.22 status from
eligibility_check (Senior/Key Personnel emit "N/A"); DGA
name from dga_mapping for the row's org_code.

Status:
- PASS = Eligible (or N/A for Senior/Key) + org code present + DGA mapped
- FAIL = APM 45.22 status "Not Eligible"
- REVIEW = APM 45.22 status "Review Required" OR ambiguous Banner match OR unmapped org code

**Status key:**

- PASS = Eligible (or N/A for Senior Personnel) + org code collected + DGA mapped
- FAIL = Not eligible per APM 45.22 (action required)
- REVIEW = Ambiguous eligibility (SPA manual review needed)

---

### SECTION 3: ORG CODE TO DGA MAPPING

| Org Code | Department | DGA Name | Personnel Count |
|----------|------------|----------|-----------------|

One row per entry in `org_code_compilation`. Look up
department + DGA in `dga_mapping`. When an org code is not
in the Department List, render Department as "— (not in
Department List)" and DGA Name as "—".

---

### SECTION 4: DGA COMPLETENESS ASSESSMENT

| DGA Name | Required (from org codes) | Listed in Section 2 | Action |
|----------|--------------------------|---------------------|--------|

One row per entry in `dga_cross_reference`. Action column:
"None" when listed_in_section_2 is true; "FLAG — Add to Section 2"
otherwise.

**Summary:**

- **Required DGAs:** <dga_cross_reference.length>
- **Listed in Section 2:** <count of listed_in_section_2 = true>
- **Missing DGAs: <count of action_needed = "FLAG — Must be added to Section 2">**

---

### SECTION 5: ACTION ITEMS

**Eligibility Issues (blocks proposal routing):**

| # | Person | Issue | Required Action |
|---|--------|-------|-----------------|

One row per eligibility_check entry where status is "Not
Eligible" or "Review Required". If none, state "No
eligibility issues identified."

**Missing DGAs (must be added to Section 2):**

| # | DGA Name | For Org Code(s) | Action |
|---|----------|-----------------|--------|

One row per dga_cross_reference entry with action_needed
"FLAG — Must be added to Section 2". If none, state "No
missing DGAs."

**Other Issues:**

Render as bulleted list, drawing from:
- personnel_verification entries with found_in_banner=false
  (potential external collaborators)
- personnel_verification entries with notes that mention
  ambiguous matches
- personnel_verification entries where current_employee is
  false (inactive / terminated)

If none, state "No other issues identified."

---

### SECTION 6: REVIEW COMPLETION CHECKLIST

- [ ] All PI/Co-PIs verified for APM 45.22 eligibility
- [ ] All timesheet org codes collected
- [ ] All org codes mapped to DGAs
- [ ] All required DGAs cross-referenced against Section 2
- [ ] Missing DGAs flagged for addition
- [ ] Ineligible personnel flagged for review
- [ ] Section 2 Review marked complete

(Render as literal "- [ ]" GitHub task-list syntax.)

## Rendering rules

- Bold every label with `**Label:**`.
- Use the literal status keys "PASS", "FAIL", "REVIEW",
  "Eligible", "Not Eligible", "Review Required", "N/A".
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE into
  prose / table.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.name: Personnel extraction completeness
validation_plan.description: Verify all personnel from VERAS Sections 2.1 and 2.2A are reflected in the matrix.

validation_plan.name: Eligibility check completeness
validation_plan.description: Verify every PI and Co-PI has an APM 45.22 eligibility determination.

validation_plan.name: Org code extraction completeness
validation_plan.description: Verify every person has a timesheet org code recorded or is flagged when no Banner record exists.

validation_plan.name: DGA mapping completeness
validation_plan.description: Verify every unique org code maps to a DGA or is flagged in the unmapped-org-codes summary.
